title: Redis Connection Pool Starvation during Flash Sale
description: Removing the 250ms debouncer buffer in webhook_processor caused connection pool exhaustion on SBI/HDFC bank callback spikes.
root_cause: External bank APIs take variable time. Without the 250ms buffer, concurrent incoming webhooks saturated Redis worker threads, causing a 45-minute outage.
verified_patch: Restore 250ms debounce or implement token-bucket rate limiting via async buffer queue.
author: Ravi K. (Staff SRE)

title: Preserve Legacy XML Token Serializer in Auth Service
description: Do not refactor the legacy XML serializer to pure JSON in auth handler.
root_cause: Two primary enterprise banking partners rely on legacy XML tokens. Refactoring to strict JSON causes authentication handshake failure on partner webhooks.
verified_patch: Keep dual serializer fallback (XML for legacy partner tokens, JSON for modern consumers).
author: Engineering Architecture Council

title: Postgres Read Replica Deadlock in Checkout Service
description: Using raw SELECT FOR UPDATE across unindexed inventory tables caused database lock cascade.
root_cause: Lock contention on cart inventory table blocked order transactions during high-concurrency peak.
verified_patch: Use optimistic locking with version fields instead of pessimistic database locks.
author: Karthik M. (Principal Architect)
